title: Recreational Shooting
intro: FREE basic shotgun safety and archery instruction by Certified Range Safety Officers. Learn how to hold, load, and shoot a shotgun, in addition to the rules of the sport. We can also teach you to hold and shoot a bow. Training bows are available.

sections.heading: Alerts
sections.markdown:
- **The Recreational Shooting Complex is open!** The Old Sawmill Rd. entrance from Holcomb Blvd. is closed. Please use the Piney Green Rd. entrance to Old Sawmill Rd. The road is closed to through traffic, but open for skeet and archery range traffic.
- **Pistol Range Closure Notice** The Pistol Range is currently closed due to mechanical issues and will remain closed until further notice. Updates will be provided as more information becomes available.

sections.heading: Two Separate Shooting Venues
sections.markdown: An eight-lane practice course with stationary targets set at known distances of 10 to 60 yards

sections.heading: Archery
sections.markdown:
**Pricing**
- Archery: $10/day
- 10 Visit Pass Cards - Ages 16 and older $80
- 10 Visit Pass Cards - Ages 10-15 $70
- 10 Visit Pass Cards - Ages 9 and younger $50
- Rental Bow: $12/day

On-site retail store available to purchase ammo, hearing and eye protection, and targets.

*Authorized MCCS patrons ages 13 and over; ages 13-17 must be under the direct supervision of parent/guardian. No one under the age of 13 is permitted at the facility. Customers must comply with all base regulations on firearms.*

sections.heading: Pistol Range
sections.markdown:
**Pricing**
- Per Day: $15/person (Discounted cards available - 10 visit pass $120)
- Pistol Rental: $12

sections.heading: Skeet
sections.markdown:
8 skeet fields with 2 trap overlays and a 5 stand overlay

Authorized ammunition - Only #7½, #8, or #9 lead shot authorized (only MCCS-purchased ammo is authorized in rental weapons)

**Pricing**
- Round of Skeet or Trap: $9 (discount cards available - 10 rounds for $75)
- 5 Stand: $10/round
- Shotgun Rental: $12/day
